name: Boat House Rum
summary: A rummy variant where players meld sets and runs and win by discarding their entire hand at once.
rules_text: Deal 10 cards to each player if two play, 7 cards if three or four play, and 6 cards if five or six play from a standard 52-card deck. Place the rest face down as stock and turn the top card up to start the discard pile. On your turn draw two cards either from the stock or from the top of the discard pile, then you may lay melds face up. Melds are three or four of a kind, or sequences of three or more same-suit cards. Ace is high or low and sequences may wrap K-A-2. You may also lay off cards onto any meld on the table. Discard one card, but not the same card you drew from the discard pile that turn. If the stock runs out, flip the discard pile without shuffling to form a new stock. The first player to lay down their whole hand at once wins. Going rummy - going out without having previously melded - doubles opponents' penalty points.
rating_reason: Rummy with hidden hands, turn-based strategy.
